evals.prompt: HR wants to see pay by employment type too (full time vs part time vs contractor), same numbers as the by_department insight. Add it to the backend.
evals.expected_output: A new GET /api/v1/insights/by_employment_type endpoint built through the full layering, with specs and regenerated swagger.
expectations: Adds a route under namespace api/v1 insights
Controller action calls authorize with the insight policy
Aggregation SQL lives in InsightRepository, not the controller or service
A new InsightService class returns a ServiceResult and is cached via InsightRepository.data_version
Adds a service spec and an rswag request spec covering 200 and 401
Adds locale keys for the success message
No user input is interpolated into SQL

evals.prompt: viewers shouldn't be able to see the salary history of employees anymore, only hr managers. fix the backend
evals.expected_output: SalaryRevisionPolicy#index? restricted to hr_manager, with policy and request specs proving viewer gets 403.
expectations: Changes the policy method, not the controller or the frontend
Policy spec asserts viewer is not permitted and hr_manager is
Request spec documents a 403 response for a viewer token
Updates the role table in references/domain.md or flags the contract change

evals.prompt: Add a 'bulk raise' endpoint: give everyone in a given country and department an X% raise effective today with reason annual_review.
evals.expected_output: A hr_manager-only endpoint whose service creates one revision per employee and updates salaries in a transaction, efficiently for thousands of rows.
expectations: Endpoint is authorized for hr_manager only and spec proves viewer gets 403
Salary changes go through salary revisions, never a direct update of employees.salary alone
Work happens in a single transaction and avoids per-row N+1 queries (insert_all / batched)
Validates percent range and country/department against reference data
Insights cache is invalidated by data version, not manual busting
